title: What does the paper's MGnify recall table look like?
body:
## What exists today

`recall parse coverage` writes `sets/recall/analysis/coverage.tbl` over all 1000 MGnify shards on the 15 October cutoffs, since `f1838ea`. It has one row per run plus hmmer. Each row holds the pairs the run reported over its own cutoff, split three ways: hmmer's best domain clears `hmmer_dom`, hmmer reported the pair with no domain over it, or hmmer did not report the pair. hmmer counts a pair when its sequence score or its best domain clears its cutoff. The paper's current table reports recall as a fraction of hmmer's, split by single and multiple domains.
